description: This PHP class represents a data model for employee distribution by subunit in the OrangeHRM system's dashboard API. It uses traits for serialization and implements normalization, encapsulating a SubunitCountPair object to structure and expose relevant subunit and count information for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunitModel
classes.description: A model class used to represent the distribution of employees across subunits in the dashboard API. It serializes a SubunitCountPair object into a structured API response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a SubunitCountPair object, setting up entity, filters, and attribute mappings for serialization.
